name: whatsapp-api-sdk
description: Typed contract and client for the whatsapp-api REST service
//: One entrypoint, `dist/`, in the workspace and when published: `npm publish` does not apply `publishConfig.exports`, and `pnpm deploy --prod` with `files: ["dist"]` would copy a package whose exports named a file it did not ship. The cost is that `dist/` must exist before anything typechecks against this package, which the root `check`/`test` scripts guarantee by building first.
